title: List of Rally Sites for Upcoming General Election
what_it_is: List of Rally Sites for Upcoming General Election

sections.label: Police designate rally sites
sections.summary: Police aim to designate two rally sites per GRC, one per SMC, and one for lunchtime rallies, with the list available on Nomination Day.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The Police aim to designate two rally sites for each Group Representation Constituency (GRC) and one rally site for each Single Member Constituency (SMC).

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: One rally site will also be designated for lunchtime rallies.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The list of rally sites will be made available at the end of nomination proceedings on Nomination Day.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: This is consistent with the approach taken for the Parliamentary General Elections with physical rallies held in 2011 and 2015.

sections.label: Police assess rally site types
sections.summary: The Police are assessing a range of sites, which can include open fields, stadiums and schools.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Indeed, the Police are assessing a range of sites.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: This can include open fields, stadiums and schools.
